# Video Editor UX

1. Keep the preview central and timeline legible.
2. Define track ordering, labels, visibility/lock/mute controls and selection semantics.
3. Synchronize playhead, preview timecode and transcript selection.
4. Distinguish source timeline time from clip-relative time.
5. Use a visible playhead, ruler, snap behavior, zoom, scroll and selected range.
6. Provide exact numeric/timecode controls as alternatives to drag.
7. Make trim/split/merge reversible; preserve source mapping for captions and overlays.
8. Show render proxy/final render distinction and truthful progress.
9. AI edit plans are structured operations with preview, validation and confirmation.
10. Test with a simple podcast, two-speaker interview, screen tutorial and fast-motion gaming clip.
